decisions.reason: The prohibition on selecting material that the guidelines say must never be clipped changes source eligibility, not the independent requirement to select clips with good hooks.
The source exclusion rule constrains which material is eligible but does not alter the requirement to select strong or valuable moments from eligible content.
The source-selection exclusion does not change the assigned clip count, batch work, or delivery obligation.

The source decision excludes prohibited source material but does not change the existing clean visual-editing standard; the separate reference to editing-style guidelines is not part of the source-selection modification being propagated.
